Disabling capture_svg still produces content; SVG is not extracted as an image

```swift title="Swift"
import HtmlToMarkdown

let _options = try HtmlToMarkdown.conversionOptionsFromJson("{\"capture_svg\":false,\"extract_images\":true}")
let result = try HtmlToMarkdown.convert(html: "<p>Below SVG:</p><svg xmlns=\"http://www.w3.org/2000/svg\" width=\"10\" height=\"10\"><rect width=\"10\" height=\"10\" fill=\"red\"/></svg>", options: _options)
debugPrint(result.content() as Any)
```
